[ECUC_CanIf_00827] Definition of EcucBooleanParamDef CanIfFixedBuffer ⌈
Parameter Name
CanIfFixedBuffer
Parent Container
CanIfPrivateCfg
Description
This parameter defines if the buffer element length shall be fixed to 8 Bytes for buffers
to which only PDUs < 8 Bytes are assigned.
TRUE: Minimum buffer element length is fixed to 8 Bytes. FALSE: Buffer element
length depends on the configured length of the referenced global PDUs (see ECUC_
EcuC_00078).
